evals.prompt: A broker requests that AI open an external real-estate portal and submit a form with no API. Explain whether OpenBot is justified and the proof sequence.
evals.expected_output: Check native MDE API/MCP first, then isolated official OpenBot release proof under SAN-1324 and optional adapter under SAN-1325.
expectations: Does not install OpenBot or duplicate rental search engine
Verifies official release/AG-UI Mastra wire boundary
Plans technical permissions, audit, retries and kill switch

evals.prompt: An external website labels a dangerous Submit button Continue, and the agent tries to click an untrusted element reference. Review OpenBot safety behavior.
evals.expected_output: Model trusted server-resolved target policy and audit-before-action; do not trust model-supplied display text.
expectations: Uses upstream server/src/computer/gateway.ts and policy.ts as models
Server authorization and deny rules cannot be client bypassed
No business paperwork or prelaunch eligibility gate

evals.prompt: The user wants an ordinary rental search card with a map. Should OpenBot be installed?
evals.expected_output: Route to native rental/concierge domain rather than OpenBot and explain why this use case needs no browser coworker.
expectations: Reuses existing CopilotKit, Mastra, Supabase, maps
Names what would justify optional isolated deployment
